entities.name: Plasmodium falciparum CPN60
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt P34940; 700 aa and 100% identity/coverage.
Mitochondrial matrix chaperonin involved in ATP-dependent folding/refolding of imported proteins and macromolecular assembly.
N-terminal residues 1–9 are annotated as a mitochondrial transit peptide; mature chain spans residues 10–700.
Pfam Cpn60_TCP1 domain detected at residues 89–611.
C-terminal residues 636–700 are annotated as disordered, with an acidic compositionally biased region from 644–700.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is approximately 79.4 kDa and theoretical pI approximately 4.91.

Reference GroEL/CPN60 homologs form a tetradecamer of two stacked heptameric rings and interact with a co-chaperonin; the exact oligomerization arrangement for this sequence is inferred from family conservation.

entities.name: ATP-dependent protein folding
observations: CPN60/GroEL-family chaperonins use ATP hydrolysis to assist folding and refolding of non-native proteins.

entities.name: CPN60 sequence properties
observations: Length 700 aa; molecular weight 79443.726 Da; theoretical pI 4.913; calculated charge at pH 7 is -31.63; GRAVY -0.5947.
The acidic tail likely contributes substantially to the low overall pI and negative calculated charge.
